title: Algerian Toast with Almond Paste
description: A twist on traditional Chinese toast, this dish combines the flavors of Algeria with the crunch of almonds. Perfect as a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: algerian paste
ingredients.notes: available at most international grocery stores

instructions: Spread a layer of algerian paste on each slice.
Sprinkle sliced almonds on top of the paste.
If desired, drizzle with zesty sauce.
Bake in the oven for 5-7 minutes, or until the almonds are fragrant.
